summary: References a SOP from another location, sharing memory when a single SOP is selected and acting as a stable geometry proxy.
common_gotchas: The referenced SOP path must resolve at cook time.
Memory sharing means upstream changes are reflected directly in the selected geometry.
Select SOP is a reference node and does not filter primitives or attributes by itself.
key_concepts: Select SOP references SOP geometry from any location.
Selecting a single SOP can share memory instead of recreating geometry.
The operator exposes one official source path parameter, sop.
